title: CTA Category Base
description: Post terms styled as CTA category links. Uppercase, CTA dark default color, underline on hover.

styles.css: & a{transition: color 200ms ease;} & a:hover{color: var(--wp--preset--color--cta-500); text-decoration: underline;} & a:active{color: var(--wp--preset--color--cta-500); text-decoration: underline;} & a:focus-visible{color: var(--wp--preset--color--cta-500); outline: 2px solid var(--wp--preset--color--focus-background); outline-offset: 2px;}
